phrases.text: Ugh, where did it go?
I'm sure I was wearing it today.
Where could it have gotten lost?
Look.
Detective Jaljal?
Yes, my assistant Tantan, what's wrong?
I lost something.
What is this thing?
I lost...
I forgot, when you startled me I forgot what I lost.
Oh, you forgot? Hmm.
I'm Detective Jaljal and I can help you remember.
Really?
So I'll find the thing I lost?
Yes, simply by asking questions I'll know what you forgot.
Okay, let's start, Detective Jaljal.
Don't worry, this is my job.
Is the thing you're looking for for you or someone else?
For me.
Excellent, okay.
Do you know, Tantan, if you were wearing the necklace you always wear?
It helps me discover things, like I knew right away what you forgot.
My necklace!
Yes yes yes, Detective Jaljal, you're the smartest detective ever.
My necklace, I lost my necklace, hey!
I am Detective Jaljal, I solve all problems.
And so my mission is over, thanks.
Jaljal Jaljal.
Detective Jaljal.
You knew that I lost the necklace.
But you didn't find it for me.
